```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9)
for (f in c("R/scores.R", "R/reliability.R", "R/suppression.R", "R/plots.R")) source(f)
questionnaire <- read.csv(params$questionnaire, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
responses <- read.csv(params$responses, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
responses$cycle <- as.character(responses$cycle)
long <- to_long(responses, questionnaire)
dims <- dimension_scores(long)
current <- max(responses$cycle)
```

## Overview

* **Respondents:** `r format(nrow(responses), big.mark = ",")` across
  `r length(unique(responses$cycle))` evaluation cycles and
  `r length(unique(responses$program))` programs.
* **Instrument:** `r nrow(questionnaire)` items in
  `r length(unique(questionnaire$dimension))` dimensions, 5-point agreement scale.
* **Anonymity rule:** results for groups with fewer than `r params$min_n`
  respondents are suppressed.

## Reliability

```{r}
knitr::kable(reliability_table(responses, questionnaire),
             col.names = c("Dimension", "Items", "Complete cases", "Cronbach's alpha",
                           "Lowest item-total r", "Weakest item"))
```

## Item results — cycle `r current`

```{r, fig.height=7.5}
plot_likert(dplyr::filter(long, cycle == current), paste("Responses by item -", current))
```

```{r}
items <- item_summary(dplyr::filter(long, cycle == current))
knitr::kable(items[, c("dimension", "item", "text", "n", "agree_pct", "disagree_pct", "index")],
             digits = 1, col.names = c("Dimension", "Item", "Statement", "n", "% agree",
                                       "% disagree", "Index (0-100)"))
```

## Dimensions by program

```{r, fig.height=4.2}
by_program <- dimension_summary(dplyr::filter(dims, cycle == current), program) |>
  suppress_small_groups(min_n = params$min_n)
plot_dimensions(by_program)
```

```{r}
tab <- by_program
tab$index <- ifelse(tab$suppressed, paste0("n < ", params$min_n), sprintf("%.1f", tab$index))
knitr::kable(tab[, c("program", "dimension", "n", "index")],
             col.names = c("Program", "Dimension", "n", "Index"))
```

## Change between cycles

```{r}
by_cycle <- dimension_summary(dims, cycle)
wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(by_cycle[, c("cycle", "dimension", "index")],
                           names_from = cycle, values_from = index)
cyc <- sort(unique(responses$cycle))
if (length(cyc) >= 2) wide$change <- wide[[cyc[length(cyc)]]] - wide[[cyc[length(cyc) - 1]]]
knitr::kable(wide, digits = 1)
```
